IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseParquetFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseParquetFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET)
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'taxidata_teststoragegithub_dfs_core_windows_net') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [taxidata_teststoragegithub_dfs_core_windows_net] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://taxidata@teststoragegithub.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO



CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.Taxi (
	[RideId] nvarchar(4000),
	[VendorId] nvarchar(4000),
	[PickupTime] nvarchar(4000),
	[DropTime] nvarchar(4000),
	[PickupLocationId] nvarchar(4000),
	[DropLocationId] nvarchar(4000),
	[CabNumber] nvarchar(4000),
	[DriverLicenseNumber] nvarchar(4000),
	[PassengerCount] nvarchar(4000),
	[TripDistance] nvarchar(4000),
	[RateCodeId] nvarchar(4000),
	[PaymentType] nvarchar(4000),
	[TotalAmount] nvarchar(4000),
	[FareAmount] nvarchar(4000),
	[Extra] nvarchar(4000),
	[MtaTax] nvarchar(4000),
	[TipAmount] nvarchar(4000),
	[TollsAmount] nvarchar(4000),
	[ImprovementSurcharge] nvarchar(4000)
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'output/data_161d0eb7-6638-4579-ac98-00b595bcc1c0_3b15003d-f890-4bb6-952e-85d58c3f57af.parquet',
	DATA_SOURCE = [taxidata_teststoragegithub_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseParquetFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.Taxi
GO
